article.headline: Gardner scores 29 in Maryland-Eastern Shore’s 81-55 victory over Cheyney (PA)
article.description: — Bobby Gardner’s 29 points helped Maryland-Eastern Shore defeat Cheyney (PA) 81-55 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Gardner scores 29 in Maryland-Eastern Shore’s 81-55 victory over Cheyney (PA)

event.description: Cheyney (PA) Wolves @ Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks

keywords: Cheyney (PA) Wolves @ Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks
article.story: PRINCESS ANNE, Md. -- — Bobby Gardner’s 29 points helped Maryland-Eastern Shore defeat Cheyney (PA) 81-55 on Saturday. Gardner also contributed six assists and five steals for the Hawks (1-2). Saadiq Moore scored 18 points while going 7 of 13 (4 for 8 from 3-point range), and added six assists. Isaiah Griffin shot 4 for 6 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points. Amare Curtis finished with 15 points and four assists for the Wolves. Treshawn Cody added 10 points, six rebounds and two blocks for Cheyney (PA). S.J. Hutchinson II finished with 10 points and two steals. Up next Maryland-Eastern Shore takes on Boston College on the road on Tuesday, and Cheyney (PA) visits Coppin State on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
